newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 3.78 bln reais in Central Bank Bonds. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 3.78 bln reais in Central Bank Bonds. [CORRECTED 19:00 GMT]

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 3.78 billion reais in 56-day and 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) at its weekly formal bond auction Tuesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank sold 2.425 billion reais in 56-day bonds at an overnight rate of 2.42 percent a month, up from 2.333 percent last week.
The 182-day bonds were sold at 2.377 percent (corrects from 2.337 percent) a month, up from 2.229 percent last week, totalling 1.355 billion reais.
The financial result of the auction indicated 720 million reais will be added to the banking system as 4.5 billion reais in 56-day old bonds are coming due Wednesday.
